title: A Visit to the Zoo
mainIdea: Spending time with family and exploring new places can create happy memories.

pages.text: Omar and his family visited the city zoo during summer vacation.
They first saw lions resting in the shade.

question.text: What did Omar's family want to do?
options: Visit the zoo and see animals
Go shopping at the big city mall

pages.text: Next, they watched giraffes eating leaves and monkeys swinging on ropes.

question.text: What animals did Omar enjoy watching?

pages.text: Omar's little sister enjoyed feeding the ducks.

question.text: What activity did Omar's sister enjoy?

pages.text: Before leaving, they bought ice cream and took a family photo. Omar said it was one of the best days of his summer.

question.text: How did Omar feel at the end?

elements.correct: To enjoy a day at the zoo
distractors: To go shopping at the mall
